meta.title: Tables Turn
meta.description: While feeling around in the dark, you finally glimpse the light.

units.rawText: At the Jupiter Ringworld base of the Jiutian Sector.
units.displayText: At the Jupiter Ringworld base of the Jiutian Sector.

spans.text: At the Jupiter Ringworld base of the Jiutian Sector.

units.rawText: The night sky is black as pitch and even the stars have dimmed. The Entropics have devoured the once-sparkling constellations, turning them into celestial tombs.
units.displayText: The night sky is black as pitch and even the stars have dimmed. The Entropics have devoured the once-sparkling constellations, turning them into celestial tombs.

spans.text: The night sky is black as pitch and even the stars have dimmed. The Entropics have devoured the once-sparkling constellations, turning them into celestial tombs.

units.rawText: A High Order Entropic floats in the void, looking through the cosmos at the newly-crowned Entropic leader.
units.displayText: A High Order Entropic floats in the void, looking through the cosmos at the newly-crowned Entropic leader.

spans.text: A High Order Entropic floats in the void, looking through the cosmos at the newly-crowned Entropic leader.

units.rawText: My strength is fading... Is the newborn queen calling me...
units.displayText: My strength is fading... Is the newborn queen calling me...

spans.text: My strength is fading... Is the newborn queen calling me...

units.rawText: It seems Lady Malkira's wish has come true. Unfortunately, I am not prepared to swear my loyalty to the new queen... Or at least, my current iteration is not.
units.displayText: It seems Lady Malkira's wish has come true. Unfortunately, I am not prepared to swear my loyalty to the new queen... Or at least, my current iteration is not.

spans.text: It seems Lady Malkira's wish has come true. Unfortunately, I am not prepared to swear my loyalty to the new queen... Or at least, my current iteration is not.

units.rawText: Then may this be my last dance for this performance, and may you applaud my exit with your screams.
units.displayText: Then may this be my last dance for this performance, and may you applaud my exit with your screams.

spans.text: Then may this be my last dance for this performance, and may you applaud my exit with your screams.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea raises her skirts and a huge horde of Entropics materializes out of thin air.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea raises her skirts and a huge horde of Entropics materializes out of thin air.

spans.text: Ptolemaea raises her skirts and a huge horde of Entropics materializes out of thin air.

units.rawText: Ship batteries take aim; target the Jellyfish Entropics. Fire—
units.displayText: Ship batteries take aim; target the Jellyfish Entropics. Fire—

spans.text: Ship batteries take aim; target the Jellyfish Entropics. Fire—

units.rawText: The Entropics are consumed by a barrage of gunfire. The targeted Jellyfish Entropic is promptly blown to smithereens, but she suddenly appears elsewhere and bows elegantly.
units.displayText: The Entropics are consumed by a barrage of gunfire. The targeted Jellyfish Entropic is promptly blown to smithereens, but she suddenly appears elsewhere and bows elegantly.

spans.text: The Entropics are consumed by a barrage of gunfire. The targeted Jellyfish Entropic is promptly blown to smithereens, but she suddenly appears elsewhere and bows elegantly.

units.rawText: Abandon your useless resistance and enjoy this last dance.
units.displayText: Abandon your useless resistance and enjoy this last dance.

spans.text: Abandon your useless resistance and enjoy this last dance.

units.rawText: Your lives shall end as a salute for the closing act of this play.
units.displayText: Your lives shall end as a salute for the closing act of this play.

spans.text: Your lives shall end as a salute for the closing act of this play.

units.rawText: Hellbore Cannon, fire—
units.displayText: Hellbore Cannon, fire—

spans.text: Hellbore Cannon, fire—

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: A dazzling flare of bluish-white light arcs across the sky. Ptolemaea can't dodge it in time and her legs are burned through by the scorching ray, leaving a set of blackened holes in them.
units.displayText: A dazzling flare of bluish-white light arcs across the sky. Ptolemaea can't dodge it in time and her legs are burned through by the scorching ray, leaving a set of blackened holes in them.

spans.text: A dazzling flare of bluish-white light arcs across the sky. Ptolemaea can't dodge it in time and her legs are burned through by the scorching ray, leaving a set of blackened holes in them.

units.rawText: Xinghuan!
units.displayText: Xinghuan!

spans.text: Xinghuan!

units.rawText: Why are you disturbing this final dance?
units.displayText: Why are you disturbing this final dance?

spans.text: Why are you disturbing this final dance?

units.rawText: Are you kidding me? We're the stars of our own shows; of course we'd pick the best stages for ourselves!
units.displayText: Are you kidding me? We're the stars of our own shows; of course we'd pick the best stages for ourselves!

spans.text: Are you kidding me? We're the stars of our own shows; of course we'd pick the best stages for ourselves!

units.rawText: Neither you nor that Eosphorus guy have the right to determine our fates! Now give our futures back—
units.displayText: Neither you nor that Eosphorus guy have the right to determine our fates! Now give our futures back—

spans.text: Neither you nor that Eosphorus guy have the right to determine our fates! Now give our futures back—

units.rawText: Heh, I shall make you exit as the choreography dictates—
units.displayText: Heh, I shall make you exit as the choreography dictates—

spans.text: Heh, I shall make you exit as the choreography dictates—

units.rawText: Ptolemaea waves her arm, trying to command her subject Entropics to heal her. However, the Entropics beside her do not obey; instead they leave to obey their new queen's command.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea waves her arm, trying to command her subject Entropics to heal her. However, the Entropics beside her do not obey; instead they leave to obey their new queen's command.

spans.text: Ptolemaea waves her arm, trying to command her subject Entropics to heal her. However, the Entropics beside her do not obey; instead they leave to obey their new queen's command.

units.rawText: The dancing girl senses something is wrong, but she can no longer move.
units.displayText: The dancing girl senses something is wrong, but she can no longer move.

spans.text: The dancing girl senses something is wrong, but she can no longer move.

units.rawText: Xinghuan pulls her trigger and bullets rain down on her enemy.
units.displayText: Xinghuan pulls her trigger and bullets rain down on her enemy.

spans.text: Xinghuan pulls her trigger and bullets rain down on her enemy.

units.rawText: Dakkadakkadakka!
units.displayText: Dakkadakkadakka!

spans.text: Dakkadakkadakka!

units.rawText: Yuwang!
units.displayText: Yuwang!

spans.text: Yuwang!

units.rawText: Sorry to keep you waiting! Coordinates locked! Target confirmed!
units.displayText: Sorry to keep you waiting! Coordinates locked! Target confirmed!

spans.text: Sorry to keep you waiting! Coordinates locked! Target confirmed!

units.rawText: The spaceship's massive operand cannon fires, and its white beam completely consumes Ptolemaea. Not even a High Order Entropic can survive an attack like this which instantly discorporates its entire body.
units.displayText: The spaceship's massive operand cannon fires, and its white beam completely consumes Ptolemaea. Not even a High Order Entropic can survive an attack like this which instantly discorporates its entire body.

spans.text: The spaceship's massive operand cannon fires, and its white beam completely consumes Ptolemaea. Not even a High Order Entropic can survive an attack like this which instantly discorporates its entire body.

units.rawText: (Sigh)
units.displayText: Sigh

spans.text: Sigh

units.rawText: Lady Malkira, this is the end.
units.displayText: Lady Malkira, this is the end.

spans.text: Lady Malkira, this is the end.

units.rawText: I wonder, were you pleased by this last dance...
units.displayText: I wonder, were you pleased by this last dance...

spans.text: I wonder, were you pleased by this last dance...

units.rawText: Her body vanishes into the light, not even leaving a trace of smoke behind.
units.displayText: Her body vanishes into the light, not even leaving a trace of smoke behind.

spans.text: Her body vanishes into the light, not even leaving a trace of smoke behind.

units.rawText: Target's signal is gone! We did it!
units.displayText: Target's signal is gone! We did it!

spans.text: Target's signal is gone! We did it!

units.rawText: Yup. Although, our fight for the future is far from over.
units.displayText: Yup. Although, our fight for the future is far from over.

spans.text: Yup. Although, our fight for the future is far from over.

units.rawText: Yuwang sends an anonymous message to Xinghuan.
units.displayText: Yuwang sends an anonymous message to Xinghuan.

spans.text: Yuwang sends an anonymous message to Xinghuan.

units.rawText: Listen to this, who is it that's speaking...
units.displayText: Listen to this, who is it that's speaking...

spans.text: Listen to this, who is it that's speaking...
